notes.text:
This update for rsyslog fixes the following issue:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-93404: omclickhouse SQL injection due improper escaping in the built-in ClickHouse `INSERT` template
  (bsc#1289824).

Other updates and bugfixes:

- Added new rsyslog (imdtls/omdtls) DTLS modules (jsc#PED-16623)
